links.outcome: Prospective silent-mode (shadow) performance of admission-risk model on live ED data
links.effect: Non-interventional shadow deployment on 3677 patients yielded AUC 0.795; 0.828 for pneumonia-related complaints, 0.755 for non-pneumonia complaints; accuracy 0.751 (PSI threshold), 0.729 (CRB threshold).
links.quote: IPRO-X predicted IP admissions with an AUC of 0.795, and in the pneumonia-specific chief complaints, AUC increased to 0.828, whereas in non-related pneumonia chief complaints, the AUC decreased to 0.755.

screen.reason: The study conducts a prospective non-interventional shadow deployment (silent mode) to validate a deep learning model predicting admission risk from chest X-rays, but does not test or compare different deployment practices or safeguards.
